title: Create HTTP Service

vars.title: HTTPService
vars.notes: rootURL is MANDATORY and must be a non-empty, latin, URL-safe token (e.g. "api", "shop") — NOT Cyrillic, no spaces, and prefer no leading slash. An empty or invalid rootURL produces the marker 'Некорректное значение свойства rootURL ... Некорректное значение URL'. The setupBlock already sets it; change "api" to a meaningful latin name. URL templates and HTTP methods are child objects added in follow-up steps. For delete CRUD, use delete_metadata_object; do not remove from Configuration and detach manually.

title: Create Task
summary: Create Task metadata with attributes and standard top-level workflow.

vars.title: Task
vars.notes: Child objects: regular attributes via mdFactory.createTaskAttribute() → task.getAttributes().add(...); tabular sections via createTaskTabularSection(). ADDRESSING attributes (реквизиты адресации) via mdFactory.createAddressingAttribute() → task.getAddressingAttributes().add(...); set its uuid and a TypeDescription. Build the TypeDescription exactly as in create_catalog: primitives via IEObjectProvider.getProxy(IEObjectTypeNames.STRING/...); a reference (e.g. an 'Исполнитель' performer pointing to CatalogRef.X) via MdProducedTypesUtil.getProducedType(transaction.getTopObjectByFqn("Catalog.X"), MdTypePackage.Literals.MD_REF_TYPE). Do NOT call .create() on platform/mcore classes and do NOT cast mdtype.* to TypeItem.
